evidence.reason: The post-switch runtime check at line 1013 verifies only existence and SHA-256. A file's execute bit is independent of its bytes, so a measured entry changed from mode 0755 to 0644 after the drain still satisfies this require and the deploy proceeds to restart triggers against an unusable entry. This is a correctness gap in the existing runtime verification, not merely a new hardening proposal; the placeholder branch remains intact.
